description: Source code implementing reference cache management, directory and entry handling, and iteration over references in a version control system (likely Git).

classes.name: ref_dir
classes.description: Represents a directory of references, containing entries and subdirectories.

classes.name: ref_entry
classes.description: Represents a reference entry, which can be a symbolic reference or a directory.

classes.name: string_slice
classes.description: Helper structure for string comparison in search operations.

classes.name: cache_ref_iterator_level
classes.description: Represents a level in the recursive reference iterator stack.

classes.name: cache_ref_iterator
classes.description: Implements an iterator over references, supporting recursion and prefix filtering.

methods.name: add_entry_to_dir
methods.description: Adds a reference entry to a directory, maintaining sorted order if applicable.

methods.name: get_ref_dir
methods.description: Retrieves the directory associated with a reference entry, filling it if incomplete.

methods.name: create_ref_entry
methods.description: Creates a new reference entry with specified name, referent, object ID, and flags.

methods.name: create_ref_cache
methods.description: Creates a new reference cache with a given store and fill function.

methods.name: free_ref_cache
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a reference cache.

methods.name: create_dir_entry
methods.description: Creates a directory entry within the reference cache.

methods.name: search_ref_dir
methods.description: Searches for a reference entry within a directory by name.

methods.name: find_containing_dir
methods.description: Finds the directory that should contain a given reference name.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Initializes a reference iterator over the cache, optionally filtered by prefix.
